title: Sam & Layla — Ep. 1 — P08: The night watch
summary: Sam guards the sapling all night, fights sleep, counts sheep, falls asleep. Time-lapse: it grows. Dawn.

lines.text: Just you and me, buddy. I'm not blinking.
lines.tts: [whispering, determined] Just you and me, buddy. I'm not blinking.
lines.note: Night: stars, moon, lit windows, fireflies. Sam sits in a sleeping bag with a headlamp + thermos facing the sapling. Owl hoot.

lines.tts: [drowsy, slowing down] Not blinking... not sleeping...
lines.note: Eyelids droop, head drops; the sapling grows a little; he snaps awake.
Second droop + snap (rule of three, silent); the sapling grows again each time.

lines.text: Maybe I'll count sheep. One sheep... two sheep...
lines.tts: [sleepy, slow] Maybe I'll count sheep. One sheep... two sheep...
lines.note: A thought bubble: little sheep jump over the sapling.
The sheep in the bubble turn into trees. He falls asleep, snoring.
The gap: Layla tiptoes in from the right with a blanket and drapes it over the snoring Sam.

lines.tts: [whispering to the little tree, kindly] And you... take your time.
lines.note: She whispers to the sapling, smiles, tiptoes out.

tail_note: TIME-LAPSE (~20 s): moon arcs, stars wheel, windows go dark, the sapling grows into a young tree taller than Sam (leaf pops), a leaf lands on his face and flutters with each snore, Pip sleeps on the fence. Dawn: sky goes indigo -> pink -> gold; birdsong.
beats: OPEN (0-4 s): night establishing — moon, stars, fireflies, lit windows, an owl hoots; Sam in his sleeping bag with a headlamp, facing the sapling.
l5 gap: the sheep in the thought bubble jump over the sapling.
